title: How to Create & Profitably Operate a Next Gen Practice
description: The session covers the changing landscape of running next-gen practices, including the use of technology to help you scale a more hands-on approach for younger, tech-savvy clients. Topics include defining your target market, embracing technology, developing a unique value proposition, and investing in your team. The session is aimed at helping wealth management professionals adapt to the changing industry landscape and position themselves for success in the years to come.
learningObjectives: Tips and tricks for pricing, tech stack, operations, scope of services, and niching
Learn what a next-gen practice looks like compared to more traditional models
